profile.name: Name
profile.unverifiedHint: Open the link we emailed you, or ask for a new one.
profile.resent: A new verification email is on its way to {{email}}.

dialog.title: Edit your name
dialog.description: Your name is shown to the people you contact about a home.

rules.different: To differ from the current password
rules.match: The same in both new-password fields

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Where you are signed in. End a session you don’t recognise.
sessions.onlyThis: Only this device is signed in.
sessions.confirmText_one: The other device is signed out at once and needs your password to come back.
sessions.confirmText_other: The {{count}} other devices are signed out at once and need your password to come back.

security.title: Security log
security.description: Sign-ins, failed attempts, password changes and signed-out sessions on your account. If you don’t recognise something, change your password.

demo.passwordOff: Password changes are turned off for this demo account — other visitors use it too.
demo.eraseOff: Deleting the account is turned off for this demo account — other visitors use it too.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Take a copy of what Keyhaven holds about you, or delete your account.

download.hint: A JSON file with your account, sessions, security log, saved homes and searches, viewings, messages and listings.
download.action: Download a copy of your data

erase.heading: Delete account
erase.hint: Deleting your account can’t be undone.
erase.title: Delete your account?

review.lead: This can’t be undone. When you delete your account:
review.signedOut: You are signed out on every device and can’t sign in again.
review.contacts: Your name, email and phone number are removed.
review.saved: Your saved homes and saved searches are deleted.
review.messages: The messages you wrote are removed from every conversation.
review.listings: Your published listings are taken off the site.
review.kept: Your account’s security log is kept: it is append-only and is never edited.

erase.passwordLead: Enter your password to confirm it’s you.
